[RFCS.3.6] **What each stream event records as.** The stream callback is the
engine's one channel, and a recording is the recordable events an integrator
keeps from it ([LFST.9.2.1]). For each `proto/stream_event_kind.proto#StreamEventKind`
member, named as that file says, a recorder must write the atom below, and
must write none for a kind that has none. A kind with no atom reaches the
stream callback only: nothing a replay injects or compares rests on it.

| Kind | Atom |
|---|---|
| `fact_assert` | `FactAssert` for a host assert. For a fact an external delivery asserts, or a host assert of a fact that holds a fact reference, the delivery's `ExternalAssert` lists it instead ([RFCS.24.1], [RFCS.24.3]). A fact a rule emitted has none: its `action_emit` records it ([RFCS.6a]), unless the event answers a host reassert ([RFCS.6.7]) |
| `fact_retract` | `FactRetract` when the integrator withdrew the fact; `FactWithdraw`, with its cause, when the engine did ([RFCS.7a]) |
| `rule_fire_begin`, `rule_fire_end` | `RuleFireAnnotation`, one each |
| `action_emit` | `FactEmit` ([RFCS.6a]) |
| `action_publish` | `FactPublish` ([RFCS.27]) |
| `action_call` | `CallIssued` ([RFCS.15.2]) |
| `tick` | `ClockAdvance` |
| `pump` | `PumpBoundary` ([RFCS.22]) |
| `type_error`, `bounds_error`, `engine_error`, `computation_error` | `TypeError`, `BoundsError`, `EngineError`, `ComputationError` respectively |
| `action_log`, `action_cache_set`, `action_cache_delete`, `rule_lhs_facts`, `timer_armed`, `fact_modify`, `action_cache_get`, `timer_fired` | none |

A replay re-derives what the kinds with no atom report: a cache write, a log
line and a cooldown window come from a rule firing again on the recorded
inputs.
